DMS_OfficerTraining.questDescriptionRule.li: questAskerReason->[asker_nameFull], a training instructor of [issuerFactionName], has passed a course notice on to the colony.
questAskerReason->[asker_nameFull], the case officer handling this for [issuerFactionName], has sent formal notice over the fleet band.
questAskerReason->The service education command of [issuerFactionName] has mailed a formal notice to [playerFactionName].

questTrainee->[trainee_nameFull] has the service record for the rank of [newTitle], but fleet command requires officers of that grade to log enough course hours before the post can be formally conferred.

questTrainee->[trainee_nameFull] is now carried on the Colonial Forces' promotion roll for [newTitle]. Regulations, however, forbid conferring that grade on anyone who has not sat a formal military training course.

questTrainee->[asker_nameFull], the officer who signed the notice, points out that [trainee_nameFull]'s promotion to [newTitle] stays on hold until formal military training produces a certificate of qualification.

questExplain->[asker_pronoun] will arrange an orbital transport to carry [trainee_nameDef] to the training establishment for a [trainingDays]-day [courseName], with board and medical care charged to the Colonial Forces.
questExplain->The fleet will requisition an orbital transport to collect [trainee_nameDef] for [trainingDays] days of instruction at the training centre running the [courseName].
questExplain->[trainee_nameDef] will train at the centre for [trainingDays] days, with board for the duration charged to the Colonial Forces.

questEndExplain->On graduation [trainee_pronoun] will be granted the rank of [newTitle] at the centre and returned to us, having gained the relevant experience and, quite possibly, shed a bad habit along the way.
questEndExplain->Once the course is complete [trainee_nameDef] will be commissioned and returned to [playerFactionName] intact.

questWarning->Note that [trainee_nameDef] falls under [issuerFactionName] military discipline for the duration of the course. Should [playerFactionName] turn hostile, the trainee will be detained as the regulations provide.
